primitives.name: Ad Reference Creation
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Marketing Studio Ad References Ad references are reusable inspiration videos a user wants to model new ads after — typically tied to a specific avatar and/or product.
primitives.assumptions: Each reference is uniquely bound to one avatar and one product; input must be valid video source.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Reference creation fails if neither --video-input nor --job is provided.

layer2.mapping: Ad reference maps to a fiber object in a category of marketing templates, where base space is (avatar, product) × time.
layer2.telemetry: Reference status (queued/completed/failed) and S3 URL upon completion.

primitives.name: Reference Source Binding
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Inputs Create an ad reference from one of two source types: - `--video-input <upload_id>` — UUID returned by `higgsfield upload create <video_path> --video`.
primitives.assumptions: Exactly one of U or J must be specified; both cannot coexist.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Invalid source type results in rejection of reference creation request.

layer2.mapping: Source binding defines kernel of transformation from raw media to reference template, parameterized by upload or job UUID.
layer2.telemetry: Successful binding verified via presence of upload_id or job_id in backend storage.

primitives.name: Avatar-Product Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **One avatar, one product per reference.** Both `--avatar` and `--product` accept a single id.
primitives.assumptions: Each reference is constrained to a single avatar and a single product; multiple bindings disallowed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Multiple avatar/product IDs result in validation error during reference creation.

layer2.mapping: Constraint enforces a Cartesian product structure (A × P) in the reference catalog, ensuring unique semantic context.
layer2.telemetry: Reference metadata includes avatar_id and product_id fields for semantic retrieval.
